channels.name: AXI4-Stream (the only channel)
channels.purpose: Transports a stream of data from source to sink.

global_signals.name: ACLK
global_signals.purpose: Single shared clock; all signals sampled on its rising edge.

global_signals.name: ARESETn
global_signals.purpose: Active-LOW reset; TVALID LOW during reset.

handshake_pairs.name: TVALID/TREADY
handshake_pairs.rule: Transfer completes when both HIGH on a rising ACLK edge; TVALID holds until TREADY; master must not wait for TREADY; slave may wait for TVALID.

dependency_graph.common_rule: All AXI4-Stream signals are sampled on the rising edge of the shared ACLK and respect ARESETn. A transfer depends solely on the coincidence of TVALID and TREADY; there is no address phase, latency model, or read/write dependency.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: A beat of TDATA + qualifiers transfers only when TVALID (master) and TREADY (slave) are both HIGH. TLAST depends on the packet boundary; routing depends on TID/TDEST.

ordering_rules.stream_order: Transfers within one stream (one TID/TDEST) are delivered in order.
ordering_rules.interconnect: An interconnect preserves per-TID ordering while routing by TDEST; ordering between different TID/TDEST values is not defined.

fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI4-Stream Protocol (ARM IHI 0051, Single Unidirectional Stream Channel)

logical_signaling_levels.name: transfer
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: TVALID and TREADY both HIGH on a rising ACLK edge.

logical_signaling_levels.name: backpressure
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: TREADY LOW; master stalls (holds TVALID + payload).

logical_signaling_levels.name: packet boundary
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: TLAST HIGH on the last transfer of a packet.

logical_signaling_levels.name: byte type
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: TKEEP/TSTRB encode data / position / null per byte lane.
